mapper.select: SELECT a.INDEX_ID AS id, a.INDEX_NAME AS text, a.PARENT_ID AS pId FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a WHERE a.IS_FINAL = '1'

SELECT COUNT(V.INDEX_DIMNSN) AS REPEAT_COUNT,V.INDEX_DIMNSN, CASE WHEN V.INDEX_DIMNSN=1 THEN '国库' WHEN V.INDEX_DIMNSN=2 THEN '地区' ELSE '' END INDEX_DIMNSN_DSCR FROM( SELECT trim(v.INDEX_DIMNSN) AS INDEX_DIMNSN FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(a.INDEX_DIMNSN, ''), ',') AS v(INDEX_DIMNSN) WHERE COALESCE(a.INDEX_DIMNSN, '') <> ''
AND a.INDEX_ID IN
#{inedxId}
ORDER BY INDEX_DIMNSN ) V GROUP BY INDEX_DIMNSN
HAVING REPEAT_COUNT > 1

SELECT COUNT(V.INDEX_PERIOD) AS REPEAT_COUNT,V.INDEX_PERIOD, CASE WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=1 THEN '日' WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=2 THEN '月' WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=3 THEN '季' WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=4 THEN '年' ELSE '' END INDEX_PERIOD_DSCR FROM( SELECT trim(v.INDEX_PERIOD) AS INDEX_PERIOD FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(a.INDEX_PERIOD, ''), ',') AS v(INDEX_PERIOD) WHERE COALESCE(a.INDEX_PERIOD, '') <> ''
AND a.INDEX_ID IN
#{inedxId}
ORDER BY INDEX_PERIOD ) V GROUP BY INDEX_PERIOD
HAVING REPEAT_COUNT > 1
mapper.update: UPDATE indicators_lib.lib_index_relation SET INDEX_STATUS='1' WHERE INDEX_ID=#{params.INDEX_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(a.IDENTITY_PROPERTY) AS SEQ FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a

SELECT * FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a WHERE 1=1
AND a.INDEX_ID = #{params.INDEX_ID}

mapper.select: CREATE TABLE indicators_lib.${params.INDEX_CORRE_TABLE} ( INDEX_ID varchar(32), ACCOUNT_PERIOD varchar(10), INDEX_DIM_CODE varchar(12), INDEX_DIM_DESCR varchar(100), DIMENSION_FLAG varchar(2), PERIOD_FLAG varchar(2), INDEX_VALUE decimal(28,2), ADD_USERID varchar(32), ADD_DATE varchar(20), MODIFY_USERID varchar(32), MODIFY_DATE varchar(20) )
